The Container Store Group, Inc. engages in the retailing of storage and organization products and solutions in the United States. The company has market cap of $462.69 million. The firm operates through two divisions, The Container Store and Elfa. It has a 23.95 P/E ratio. The Company’s retail stores provide various lifestyle products, including bath, box, closets, collections, containers, gift packaging, hooks, kitchen, laundry, office, shelving, storage, trash, and travel, as well as elfa branded products.
